Method.Source: private void updateDueDate() { update_recordset custtransOpen setting DueDate = updatedDueDate join custTrans where custtransOpen.REFRECID == custTrans.RECID && custtransOpen.DATAAREAID == dataAreadId && custtransOpen.ACCOUNTNUM == custAccNum && custTrans.INVOICE == custInvoiceId && custTrans.AmountCur == amountCur && custTrans.APPROVED == NoYes::Yes && (custTrans.TRANSTYPE == LedgerTransType::None || custTrans.TRANSTYPE == LedgerTransType::Sales || custTrans.TRANSTYPE == LedgerTransType::CollectionLetter || custTrans.TRANSTYPE == LedgerTransType::Project || custTrans.TRANSTYPE == LedgerTransType::Cust || custTrans.TRANSTYPE == LedgerTransType::Interest || custTrans.TRANSTYPE == LedgerTransType::Transfer || custTrans.TRANSTYPE == LedgerTransType::GeneralJournal); }

Method.Source: private void updateCustDispute(TransDate _changeDate) { update_recordset custDispute setting status = collectionStatus, StatusChangedDate = _changeDate, FollowUpDate = followUpDate, AmountCur = disputedAmount, TransactionBalance = disputedAmount, note = note where custDispute.CustTrans == CustTrans.RecId; }
